notes: Source is the managing company's own reports (כלל פנסיה וגמל בע"מ, חברה מנהלת, wholly owned by כלל חברה לביטוח, itself held by the listed כלל החזקות עסקי ביטוח), published on clalbit.co.il (אודות קבוצת כלל > נתונים ומידע, דוחות כספיים > company 'כלל פנסיה וגמל'). MAYA and the parent's reports were not used. Each fact carries doc (board = דוח הדירקטוריון, biz = דוח תיאור עסקי התאגיד, fs = הדוחות הכספיים) and the 1-based PDF page of that document. Annual periods take the fund-type tables from the business description (the annual directors' report does not print them); quarterly periods print them in the directors' report.

The report prints the two new pension funds in separate columns (fund_type) and the provident products in four separate columns plus a 'סך הכל' column covering all of them; no pension-only or provident-only subtotal is printed. Nothing was added up: segment pension_new = fund_type מקיפות + כלליות, segment provident = the four provident fund_types (קופות גמל אישיות לתגמולים ופיצויים, קרנות השתלמות, קופת גמל להשקעה, קופות מרכזיות), segment total = the printed 'סך הכל' column. The company manages no veteran pension fund (pension_veteran not applicable). Operating-segments-note facts (table = operating segments note) are the company's own split into pension (segment pension_new) and provident (segment provident, which includes the provident funds the company manages for its parent), the adjustments column (segment 'other') and the total.

Window convention: the fund-type tables are cumulative from 1 January for the report period (Q1 = three months, window q; Q2 = six months, ytd; Q3 = nine months, ytd; 31 December dates = full year, fy); the table header prints only 'ליום <date>'. Balance items are instant. Stand-alone three-month columns are printed only in the segment note and in the directors' report operating-results table (Q2 and Q3 reports). Comparative sets printed in each report (prior-year period and the previous year end) are included with their own dates.

Units: amounts in NIS thousands as printed; members in counts (pension funds: members; provident funds: member accounts, per the report's footnote); fee rates in percent. Fee rates in the fund-type table are printed separately for active members, inactive members and pensioners (member_status); no blended rate is printed there, so none is given. The annual FS note 18ב prints blended average rates per pension fund (table = financial statements note 18ב; fee_rate_from_assets has member_status total). Net transfers are not printed (gross transfers in and out only); none calculated.

aum is the row 'סה"כ נכסים מנוהלים, נטו' (includes assets of pensioners); aum_active / aum_inactive and members_active / members_inactive are the rows above it. total_payments = 'סה"כ תשלומים' (redemptions plus pension payments for pension funds). reinsurers_share_of_deposits is printed negative.

selling_and_marketing_expenses (עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות) includes the net change in deferred acquisition costs (acquisition commissions are capitalised and amortised; annual note 21 shows 'שינוי בהוצאות רכישה נדחות'). The annual note 7 prints additions and current amortisation by segment (dac_additions, dac_amortisation, deferred_acquisition_costs_balance; segment provident = funds owned by the company); interim reports do not print them.

Two presentations of the same income statement are recorded and share metric names, distinguished by doc and note: (a) the operating segments note (doc fs: pension / provident / other (= adjustments) / total, parent-related items allocated to the adjustments column); (b) the directors' report operating-results table (doc board), which shows the income-statement lines gross, with the fees of funds managed for the parent (component funds_managed_for_parent) deducted on a separate line (management_fees_transferred_to_parent) and the reimbursement of expenses from the parent as a separate negative line (reimbursement_of_expenses_from_parent). Hence general_and_administrative_expenses and selling_and_marketing_expenses differ between (a) and (b). In the annual files the fee lines come from the FS note 18ב (component own_funds / funds_managed_for_parent).
